questions.markdown:
Design DFAs to accept following languages

i) $L = \{w \in \{a\}^* : |w| \bmod 3 \ne |w| \bmod 2\}$

ii) $L = \{w \in \{a,b\}^* : \text{ Every run of a's has length 2 or 3}\}$

Apply NFA to DFA method to find an equivalent DFA to accept the Language

$L = \{\text{abab}^n \cup \text{aba}^n : n \ge 0\}$ with $\Sigma = \{a,b\}$.

questions.markdown:
Given $L_1 = L(\mathrm{bba}^*\mathrm{baa}^*)$ & $L_2 = L(\mathrm{ab}^*)$, find Right Quotient $L_1/L_2$ using DFA method.
Draw the final DFA for $L_1/L_2$.
Explain the terms Right linear grammar and Left linear grammar. Construct Left linear grammar and right linear grammar for the language $L((\mathrm{aab}^*\mathrm{ab})^*)$ with exactly 3 variables.
Construct CFG that generate a language consisting of equal number of a's and b's and leftmost derivation for the string "aabbab".

Illustrate inherently ambiguous grammar. Justify the language

$L = \{a^{2n}b^{2n}c^{2m}\} \cup \{a^{2m}b^{2n}c^{2n}\}$

is inherently ambiguous with $n$ and $m$ being non-negative number.

Convert the following CFG to Chomsky Normal Form.

$S \to aBC \mid bAb \mid aC \mid E$

$A \to aB \mid aAA \mid abb \mid d$

$B \to bD \mid cD \mid dD$

$C \to aC \mid D \mid \lambda$

$D \to ab \mid ac \mid aF$

$E \to a \mid b \mid c$

$F \to aF.$

questions.markdown:
Some properties of the context free languages are listed below.

i) Union

ii) Concatenation

iii) Star closure

Verify the properties on context free languages with suitable examples.

Define instantaneous descriptions of pushdown automata. Provide the instantaneous description in processing the string 'baababba' by the pushdown automaton for the language given below.

$$
L = \{w \in \{a,b\}^* : n_a(w) = n_b(w)\}
$$

Design non-deterministic pushdown automata that recognize the following language, $L$. Draw the transition diagram for the push down automata. Mention the septuple specification for it.

$$
L = \{a^i b^j c^k d^l : i = k \text{ or } j = l\}
$$
Design a Turing Machine (TM) that act as a copier on strings of 1's. Demonstrate the working of the designed TM on the string '111' with the help of instantaneous descriptions.

Check whether the languages given below can be accepted by Linear Bounded Automata (LBA) or not and justify your answer with suitable examples.

i) $L = \{ww : w \in (a,b)^+\}$

ii) $L = \{www^R : w \in (a,b)^+\}$
Define grammar with a suitable example.
